verdict.rationale: Azure publishes a canonical, per-service REST API specification repository and uniform REST reference pages on Microsoft Learn, with a consistent api-version convention and a Try It console. Together these show a platform-wide API reference that extends beyond flagship services. CLI reference depth per service is not evidenced, client libraries cover only "most" services, and there is no independent confirmation of consistent quality across services. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service CLI command reference across all services, proof of uniform reference coverage for long-tail services, hands-on or independent corroboration of consistency.

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: This repository is the canonical source for REST API specifications for Microsoft Azure.
The same pages document the api-version query-string convention every Azure REST request requires
Azure CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources with interactive commands or scripts.
Most Azure service REST APIs have client libraries that provide a native interface for using Azure services
